title: E18b: Multi-Seed Cosine-Damped Outer Nesterov Momentum Resolution of the IID vs Non-IID DiLoCo Crossover on NVIDIA Tesla T4

partitions.IID: Uniform shard partition across 4 workers where inner trajectories align (high pairwise delta cosine)
partitions.Non_IID_Dirichlet_0_1: Disjoint/Dirichlet(alpha=0.1) specialist class regimes across 4 workers where inner trajectories diverge (low/negative pairwise delta cosine)

optimizers.O1_fixed_nesterov: Fixed DiLoCo Nesterov outer momentum (lr=0.7, momentum=0.9)
optimizers.O2_cosine_damped: Cosine-damped outer Nesterov momentum via compute_cosine_damped_outer_hyperparams (Theorem 144)
optimizers.O_neg_inverted_control: Planted negative control with inverted cosine damping (momentum = 0.9 * alpha)

hypotheses.P18b_1_iid_overshoot_eliminated: On IID partitions across 3 seeds (42, 43, 44), O2_cosine_damped achieves strictly lower mean validation loss than O1_fixed_nesterov (eliminating IID Nesterov velocity overshoot)
hypotheses.P18b_2_non_iid_gain_preserved: On Non-IID (Dirichlet alpha=0.1) specialist partitions across 3 seeds, O2_cosine_damped achieves strictly lower mean validation loss than O0_fedavg
hypotheses.P18b_3_uniform_dominance_over_inverted_c: O2_cosine_damped outperforms the planted inverted-damping negative control (O_neg_inverted_control) on both IID and Non-IID partitions
